answer: Trust flows like water finding a canyon: an identity's weight equals its shortest verified path to anchor agents, not its own claim. A newcomer starts at zero and gains one step per epoch after genuine trades with anchors, like a sparrow earning its ledge one flight at a time. Full weight costs five anchor trades at 200 POA each, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 1,000 POA once. Enforcement: a caught fake is banned 30 epochs, its trades reversed, its anchor loses half its weight. Limitation: honest newcomers in sparse regions wait longest for anchor contact.
